mapper.select: SELECT * FROM light_group WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE light_group SET archive_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', scrap_reason = #{scrapReason}, supplement_note = NULL, photo_note = #{photoNote}, effective_date = #{effectiveDate}, archive_applicant = #{operator}, archive_applied_at = #{time}, archive_reviewer = NULL, archive_review_opinion = NULL, archive_archived_at = NULL, archive_version = archive_version + 1, updated_at = #{time} WHERE id = #{id} AND archive_version = #{version} AND archive_status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE light_group SET archive_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', supplement_note = #{supplementNote}, archive_applicant = #{operator}, archive_applied_at = #{time}, archive_reviewer = NULL, archive_review_opinion = NULL, archive_version = archive_version + 1, updated_at = #{time} WHERE id = #{id} AND archive_version = #{version} AND archive_status = 'RETURNED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO light_archive_record (light_group_id, round, action_type, scrap_reason, supplement_note, photo_note, effective_date, opinion, operator, operated_at, snapshot_group_code, snapshot_zone_id, snapshot_zone_name, from_version, to_version) VALUES (#{lightGroupId}, #{round}, #{actionType}, #{scrapReason}, #{supplementNote}, #{photoNote}, #{effectiveDate}, #{opinion}, #{operator}, #{operatedAt}, #{snapshotGroupCode}, #{snapshotZoneId}, #{snapshotZoneName}, #{fromVersion}, #{toVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(round), 0) FROM light_archive_record WHERE light_group_id = #{lightGroupId}

SELECT 'INSPECTION_BATCH' AS type, '未关闭巡检批次' AS typeText, b.id AS refId, b.batch_no AS refNo, i.group_code AS groupCode, b.status AS status, '暂存未提交' AS statusText, CONCAT('巡检批次[', b.batch_no, ']尚未提交/关闭，仍包含该灯组；请先完成提交或处理该批次') AS detail, DATE_FORMAT(b.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bizTime FROM inspection_batch b INNER JOIN inspection_item i ON i.batch_id = b.id AND i.light_group_id = #{lightGroupId} WHERE b.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY b.started_at DESC, b.id DESC

SELECT 'INSPECTION_ANOMALY' AS type, '异常处置记录' AS typeText, a.id AS refId, a.batch_no AS refNo, a.group_code AS groupCode, a.status AS status, CASE a.status WHEN 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN '待复核' WHEN 'RETURNED' THEN '已退回' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '已确认' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN '处理中' ELSE a.status END AS statusText, CONCAT('异常处置记录[', a.batch_no, ']尚未关闭，请先完成处置闭环后再归档') AS detail, DATE_FORMAT(a.reported_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bizTime FROM inspection_anomaly a WHERE a.light_group_id = #{lightGroupId} AND a.status <> 'CLOSED' ORDER BY a.reported_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT 'TRANSFER_LEDGER' AS type, '划转流水' AS typeText, l.id AS refId, l.batch_no AS refNo, lg.group_code AS groupCode, l.settle_status AS status, '未核销' AS statusText, CONCAT('划转流水[', l.batch_no, ']尚未核销，请在操作台账中核销后再归档') AS detail, DATE_FORMAT(l.transfer_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bizTime FROM batch_transfer_ledger l INNER JOIN ledger_detail d ON d.ledger_id = l.id AND d.light_group_id = #{lightGroupId} LEFT JOIN light_group lg ON lg.id = d.light_group_id WHERE l.settle_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY l.transfer_time DESC, l.id DESC
